firefoxRetest: Not performed: user confirmed original tab was closed; reopening was not confirmed and Firefox processes were absent in these samples. Browser tools exposed only in-app browser/MCP Apps.

beforeFixObservation.interpretation: Do not sum RSS as unique memory. User-confirmed tab closure was followed by release of the large shared allocation. The concrete bitmap cleanup gap and canvas allocation churn were independently reproduced/reviewed; no isolated causality claim.

limits: One sampled in-app renderer process, not a per-tab JavaScript heap or all-browser measurement.
Viewport changes, screenshots and other desktop activity can affect this process.
Twenty minutes does not establish a whole-day plateau or prove absence of all memory leaks.
